verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack covers security alerts: no ingestion of scanner or vulnerability alerts, no validation of whether an alert is real, and no automatic remediation pull requests for them. The closest items are general-purpose: Devin Review Auto-Fix fixes bugs flagged in code review and CI failures, and the API, scheduling and MCP integrations could support custom automation. None of these is shown to handle security alerts, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
